_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Mo ke na Golf (Koti ti Jeux) - Joueur {player_id}.
Mokonzonzo: Få ndo ti mo ke na score ya basse so mo ke na tour unique. Si colonne e partager valeur mêmé, a e sommer na 0.
Valeur ti Koti: A=1, 2-10=valeur ti figure, J/Q=10, K=0

Actions (utiliser crochets exacts):
- '[draw]' - Tirer na pioche
- '[take]' - Prendre na pile ti défausse
- '[swap X Y]' - Échanger carte tirée na position X (ligne) Y (colonne)
- '[discard]' - Défausser carte tirée

board.drew:
Mo ke tirer: {card}
Mo ke doit [swap X Y] ou [discard] li.
board.took:
Mo kôsi: {card} na pile ya kôsi
Mo loké na [swap X Y] na yé (mo pêpê kôsi yé).
board.peeked: Zɛ na kɔzo kɔlɔ kwa pozisiɔn ({row},{col}): {card}

options.final_turns: Kɔlɔ kɔlɔ kɔlɔ! Sɔnzɔ ŋɔ: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: A lingbi mo: [swap X Y] (mo peut ti zi carte na yâ molongo ni pëpe)
options.swap_or_discard: Zɛ na kɛ mbɛnɛ: [swap X Y] ɛzɛnɛ [discard]

hand.no_cards: A yeke wara carte na yâ ni ape.

message.deck_empty: A zi yâ ti ndo ni kue awe! Ngia ni ahunzi fade fadeso.
message.knocked: Zo ti pikango ye {pid} atï na sese! Mbeni zo oko ayeke kiri ande.
message.final_round: Atiki {pid} {reason}! Atiki ôko ôko na ndö môko.

invalid.wrong_action: Utiliser exactement UN action entre crochets: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], ou [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: A zia mbeni ye na yâ ti gbâ ni pëpe!
invalid.must_draw_first: Mo ke doit d'abord [draw], [take], [knock], ou [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Mo lingbi pëpe ti bi mbeni carte so a mû ni na yâ molongo ti acarte, me mo doit ti changé ni.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Zɛ na kɔzo kɔlɔ. Zɛ na kɛ mbɛnɛ [swap X Y] ɛzɛnɛ [discard] ɛzɛnɛ.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Mo yeke na bezoin ti mbeni carte so a gboto ni awe si mo lingbi ti changé.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: A hunda ti tene mo bi mbeni carte na lê ni.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Position hors limites. Utiliser ligne 1-{max_row}, colonne 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Mo lingbi pëpe ti pika yanga na mbeni carte so a gboto ni awe.
invalid.already_knocked: Mbeni zo ahon awe na yâ ti molongo so.

board_str.title: === GAMÉ DE GOLF=== Lo yeke na yâ ti mbeni kota da so a leke ni nzoni.
board_str.discard: Kete ndo so a lingbi ti bi ni na gigi: {card}
board_str.knocked: Zo ti pikango ndembo ni {pid} apika yanga-da!
